lean.statement:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace E] [inst_4 : BorelSpace E] (W : E → ℝ),
  ContDiff ℝ 1 W →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (-W x)) MeasureTheory.volume →
      have μ := MeasureTheory.volume.tilted fun x => -W x;
      ∀ (D : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℝ 2 μ) →ₗ.[ℝ] ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp E 2 μ)),
        D.IsClosable →
          (∀ (u : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℝ 2 μ)) (G : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp E 2 μ)),
              (u, G) ∈ D.graph ↔ ∃ f, ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) f ∧ HasCompactSupport f ∧ ↑↑u =ᵐ[μ] f ∧ ↑↑G =ᵐ[μ] gradient f) →
            ∀ (u : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℝ 2 μ)) (G : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp E 2 μ)),
              (u, G) ∈ D.closure.graph →
                MeasureTheory.LocallyIntegrable (fun x => ↑↑u x) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                  MeasureTheory.LocallyIntegrable (fun x => ↑↑G x) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                    ∀ (ψ : E → ℝ),
                      ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ →
                        HasCompactSupport ψ →
                          ∀ (v : E),
                            MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => ψ x * inner ℝ (↑↑G x) v) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                              MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => ↑↑u x * (fderiv ℝ ψ x) v) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                ∫ (x : E), ψ x * inner ℝ (↑↑G x) v = -∫ (x : E), ↑↑u x * (fderiv ℝ ψ x) v
approved_definition_context: Lp functions are equivalence classes modulo almost-everywhere equality; displayed coercions choose measurable representatives.
A partial linear map has a linear domain and graph. IsClosable means its topological graph closure is single-valued; closure denotes that extension.
The tilted measure normalizes the exponential of its potential relative to the base measure.
LocallyIntegrable for volume means integrability on a neighborhood of each point. ContDiff order1 denotes genuine continuously Frechet differentiable; infinite order means smooth.
